tool: Playwright CLI with an isolated Chrome session

checks.result: After the final OCR-port and schema-order fixes, the operator started one deterministic fake audit, received server-event updates, reached 1/1 completed, and opened the persisted audit result.
The result view showed the waybill, vehicle, platform loading and unloading values, independent fake-ticket values, and the normal shadow outcome.
A final full page reload restored the completed Job from file-backed temporary SQLite.
A real browser double-click created exactly one additional Job; the task list contained two completed Jobs rather than three.
The first Tab focused the skip link and Enter moved focus to MAIN#main-content.
The final browser session had zero console errors or warnings. Every observed request used http://127.0.0.1:8877; no external request was present.

limitations: The four layouts were validated by equivalent CSS viewports. Changing the Windows desktop scaling setting itself was intentionally not automated; this is not evidence of a native Windows DPI test.
Formal screen-reader testing and real finance-user acceptance remain later human checks; semantic landmarks, labels, focus order, and reduced motion were covered by code and browser inspection.
